description: Use this when someone asks for a strength, gym, weightlifting or muscle-building program or workout plan, at a gym or at home. Builds all 26 weeks from Almost Fire's plan engine, the one the app uses: the split for their days, each session's exercises with sets, reps, rest and effort, a lighter week to end each block, and gentler swaps for anything they protect. No account needed. Ask how many days they can train first; fill the rest from what they've said and leave the others null. Do not use for running or race plans, sport-specific conditioning, diet plans or injury rehab.

buildPriorities.description: Up to two areas to build most.

equipment.description: commercial (a full gym), home (a home gym with a rack) or dumbbells only.

goal.description: strength, muscle or fat_loss; null when they haven't said.

protect.description: Areas to go easy on (a sore knee, a shoulder): the plan picks gentler options there.

sessionMinutes.description: How long a session can be.

split.description: full, upper_lower, ppl or body_part; auto or null picks the one that suits their days.

style.description: How they like to train: supersets, straight sets, heavy, pump, machines, free weights, a finisher.

name: make_plan
title: Make a training plan
